0022600105.text: The Nets, the second game of their season, are 0-1 and 9th in the East, 1.5 games back in the Atlantic and fourth in the division, while the Cavaliers are also 0-1 after one game, sitting 12th in the East and third in the Central, one game back. Brooklyn lost all three meetings with Cleveland in the 2025-26 season, most recently 106-102 in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. Tyler Bilodeau is listed as day-to-day with a shoulder injury and is a game-time decision for the Nets.
